# Desktop dependency license texts

These unchanged upstream license files supplement NuGet packages that declare an MIT SPDX expression but omit the license text. `provenance.json` pins the repository commit, source URL, exact bytes and covered package versions. Package upgrades require refreshing this mapping; the desktop packaging script verifies hashes and the package repository commit before use.

The build also copies package-provided licenses/notices, the resolved self-contained .NET runtime and apphost notices, engine notices, and Source Sans font licensing. Avalonia.BuildServices is build tooling; retaining its notice does not imply that tooling ships as editor runtime code. This directory is not a claim that every transitive source-level attribution has been independently audited.
